Industry developments and the questions they raise for custom fasteners.
Electric mobility: review the complete enclosure interface
The IEA Global EV Outlook 2026 examines electric vehicles and charging infrastructure. It provides market context, not a fastener specification.

Our engineering interpretation: for a charging or storage enclosure, define the joint before choosing a screw. Review the panel stack, gasket compression, coating allowance and service access together. A security drive alone does not establish sealing, corrosion resistance or electrical safety.
Factory automation: specify the function of each locating surface
IFR World Robotics tracks industrial robot deployment. The report is industry context; it does not validate a particular fixture or ZUFEK product.

Our engineering interpretation: separate clamping, pivoting and locating functions. For a shoulder screw, specify the mating bore, axial clearance and accepted final surface condition. For replacement parts, control drawing revisions and lot identification so that nominally similar screws are not treated as interchangeable.
